meta.title: Clarix — RFQ Comparison for Procurement Teams
meta.description: Create RFQs, collect supplier quotes via form or PDF, and compare them with AI-powered recommendations.

demo.bannerText: Sample data, read-only — explore freely, nothing is saved.
demo.printNote: Demo data: a sample workspace, not a real company.
demo.entryNote: A sample contractor's last six months. Read-only, no signup.
demo.pageDescription: Walk through six months of RFQs, supplier quotes, AI recommendations and auto-approved purchase orders. No signup.
demo.heading: Walk through six months of procurement at Al Waha Contracting.
demo.intro: A complete sample workspace: every quote compared, every purchase order explained. Click anything — nothing you do here is saved.
demo.tour1Body: Construction supplies, office equipment, packaging and spare parts — drafts, open requests, and decisions already made.
demo.tour2Body: The fast, cheap one. The reliable one that always quotes a long warranty. The one that never quotes a warranty at all.
demo.tour3Body: Purchase orders that went out automatically, and the ones Clarix held back for a human — with the AI's reasoning in numbers.

negotiate.title: Negotiate with
negotiate.descHigher: Clarix drafts a polite counter-offer from this supplier's own quote. You can edit it before sending.
negotiate.descLowest: This supplier's offer is the most competitive so far. The draft asks whether they can improve their terms.
negotiate.descUnknown: This quote leaves some lines unpriced. The draft asks the supplier to complete it and share their best price.
negotiate.privacy: Other suppliers' names and prices are never shared, and every message is checked before it goes out.
negotiate.targetError: Whole number from 1 to 50, or leave it empty to ask for their best price.
negotiate.hintEmpty: Leave empty to ask for their best price.
negotiate.hint30: The best other offer is 30% or more lower. Only the percentage you enter is mentioned.
negotiate.hintUnder5: The best other offer is less than 5% lower. Only the percentage you enter is mentioned.
negotiate.hintAbout: The best other offer is about {pct}% lower. Only the percentage you enter is mentioned.
negotiate.revealing: This is close to the real gap, so the supplier could work out the competing price. A rounder number is safer.
negotiate.subject: Subject
negotiate.stale: You changed the language or target. Redraft to apply it before sending.
negotiate.confirmReplace: Replace your edited message with a new draft?
negotiate.demoOff: Sending is turned off in the demo.
negotiate.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
negotiate.sent: Sent to {supplier}. Their reply will come to your email.
